name: Wokwi 模拟器
description: Wokwi 嵌入式电路模拟器：用 wokwi-cli 在本地/云端仿真引擎上运行 Arduino/ESP32/STM32 等固件，串口输出实时可测、自动化场景断言、电路图校验、截图。

projectTypes.title: Wokwi 模拟项目
projectTypes.description: Wokwi 仿真项目：Arduino 固件（.ino）+ 电路图（diagram.json）+ 仿真配置（wokwi.toml）——编译固件后可本地模拟运行，串口输出实时回传

scaffold.content:
# Wokwi 项目配置：编译固件路径（wokwi_compile_arduino 或 arduino-cli 生成到 build/）
# 也可改为指向已存在的固件（ESP32 用 build/flasher_args.json、PlatformIO 用 .hex/.elf 等）
[wokwi]
version = 1
firmware = 'build/{name}.ino.hex'
elf = 'build/{name}.ino.elf'
# Arduino 库依赖（每行一个库名，如 Servo / DHT sensor library）

settings.title: WOKWI_CLI_TOKEN
settings.description: Wokwi CI token（https://wokwi.com/dashboard/ci 生成，wok_ 开头共 44 字符）。不配置时模拟会因无授权失败；此值作为 WOKWI_CLI_TOKEN 环境变量注入所有 wokwi 命令子进程。

tools.name: wokwi_lint
tools.description: Validate the Wokwi diagram.json of the current project for errors/warnings (unknown parts, invalid pin connections, missing components). Read-only, safe. Returns lint output.

tools.name: wokwi_run
tools.description: Run the Wokwi simulation of the current project for `timeout` milliseconds. Uses the firmware path from wokwi.toml (compile first with wokwi_compile_arduino for Arduino projects). Streams the simulated serial output live. Exit code 42 = normal timeout end. Requires WOKWI_CLI_TOKEN configured.

tools.name: wokwi_ci_test
tools.description: CI-style Wokwi test: run the simulation until `expectText` appears in serial output (pass) or `failText` appears (fail), bounded by `timeout`. Use to verify firmware behavior automatically. Returns the serial output and pass/fail verdict. Requires WOKWI_CLI_TOKEN.

expectText.description: Text that must appear in serial output for success.

failText.description: Text that causes failure if found (use 'none' if no fail text).

tools.name: wokwi_scenario
tools.description: Run a Wokwi automation scenario (YAML: set-control/delay/wait-serial/write-serial/touch etc.) against the current project to drive virtual buttons/sensors and assert serial output. Returns scenario progress + serial. Requires WOKWI_CLI_TOKEN.

scenario.description: Path to the scenario YAML file (relative to project, e.g. 'test/scenario.yaml').

tools.name: wokwi_screenshot
tools.description: Run the simulation and capture a screenshot of a specific part (e.g. an OLED display) at `time` ms, saving to `outFile`. Useful to verify visual output. Requires WOKWI_CLI_TOKEN.

partId.description: Part id in diagram.json to screenshot (e.g. 'oled1').

time.description: Simulation time in ms when to take the screenshot (default 3000).

outFile.description: Output file path (relative to project, e.g. 'screenshot.png').

tools.name: wokwi_compile_arduino
tools.description: Compile the current Arduino .ino project to firmware for Wokwi simulation using arduino-cli (must be on PATH, e.g. installed by the Arduino plugin or manually). Outputs to build/ and wokwi.toml points to it. Returns compile result; then run wokwi_run.

fqbn.description: Arduino board FQBN matching the diagram board (default arduino:avr:uno for Arduino Uno).

tools.name: wokwi_get_status
tools.description: Show Wokwi CLI version and connectivity (verifies the detected wokwi-cli works). Read-only, safe.

skills.name: wokwi-sim
skills.description: Wokwi 电路模拟流程：校验图 → 编译固件 → 运行模拟 → 读串口 → 自动化断言
skills.prompt:
按 Wokwi 模拟工作流：
1. 先用 wokwi_lint 校验 diagram.json（改过电路后必做）
2. Arduino 项目用 wokwi_compile_arduino 编译固件到 build/（fqbn 与 diagram 板子一致）
3. 用 wokwi_run 运行模拟（timeout 按需），读串口输出验证行为
4. 要自动断言用 wokwi_ci_test（expectText/failText）；要驱动虚拟按键/传感器用 wokwi_scenario
5. 未配置 WOKWI_CLI_TOKEN 时提示用户在插件设置页配置（wokwi-cli 云端引擎需要授权）
